what: A turbulent pattern in a four-color palette slowly melts and flows inside a large logo/wordmark shape (svg) in WebGL2. The pattern bakes along the shape’s depth (distance from the edge inward) and the edges are bright, so it looks like glass. When the cursor passes, its velocity is stacked into a half-resolution push field with an elliptical brush (radius .09, stretched in the direction of movement) that pushes the pattern. Each frame the field blends .12 with its neighbors and decays by a factor of .895

options.bend: Strength of bending along the edge, default 1
options.contour: Edge brightening and inner tightening, default .8
options.scale: Pattern scale, default .3 — smaller means bolder bands
options.speed: Flow speed, default .4 (0 gives a still pattern)
options.push: Cursor push strength, default .8 (0 means no cursor reaction)
options.radius: Cursor brush radius (× .1 of cell height), default .9
options.persist: How much of the smear trail remains (0~1, .86~.985 multiplier per frame), default .28
options.stretch: How much the brush stretches in the direction of motion, default 1
options.--fx-c1~--fx-c4: Palette of four cells (css variables, color-mix possible) — light → accent → deep accent. The default is derived from --kf-accent. If the last cell matches the background, the shape looks like glass melting into the background

use: — The shape sits inside the cell, scaled to fit (contain)
note: The depth of the shape is measured at attach time as a 3-4 erosion distance on a buffer and spread over a 6-cell radius (the original uses a design-tool height map). The palette is a straight OKLab mix (the original mixes on an LCH color wheel — with same-family colors the difference is almost nil). The starting phase of the turbulence is a fixed value different from the original random seed (0), so the pattern has the same grain but is not identical. Without a float buffer (EXT_color_buffer_float) there is only flow with no cursor push, and without WebGL2 the shape stays in the accent color. With reduced motion, only one still frame is drawn.

from.where: index.html .gu-nu (large center logo in the Hero — original Shader ‹Logo Gradient›, four purple colors rgb(208,138,255)·(170,43,255)·(152,32,232)·(137,17,217), motionMode melt)
